mapper.sql: notice.notice_id, notice.notice_type_id, notice.title, notice.all_visible_flag, notice.scheduled_publish_flag, notice.publish_time, notice.content_text, notice.content_html, notice.attachment, notice.page_view_count, notice.user_view_count, notice.source, notice.author, notice.document_number, notice.deleted_flag, notice.create_user_id, notice.update_time, notice.create_time
mapper.insert:
insert into notice_visible_range (notice_id, data_type, data_id) values
( #{noticeId} , #{item.dataType}, #{item.dataId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT , notice_type.notice_type_name as noticeTypeName, employee.actual_name as createUserName FROM notice LEFT JOIN notice_type on notice.notice_type_id = notice_type.notice_type_id LEFT JOIN employee on notice.create_user_id = employee.employee_id
AND notice_type.notice_type_id = #{query.noticeTypeId}
AND ( INSTR(notice.title,#{query.keywords}) OR INSTR(notice.author,#{query.keywords}) OR INSTR(notice.source,#{query.keywords}) )
AND INSTR(notice.document_number, #{query.documentNumber})
AND employee.actual_name = #{query.createUserName}
AND notice.deleted_flag = #{query.deletedFlag}
AND DATE_FORMAT(notice.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.createTimeBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(notice.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.createTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(notice.publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.publishTimeBegin}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(notice.publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.publishTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY notice.publish_time DESC, notice.notice_id DESC
mapper.insert: insert into notice_view_record (notice_id, employee_id, first_ip, first_user_agent, page_view_count) values (#{noticeId}, #{employeeId}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{pageViewCount})
